messages:
elaine_pm: Heads-up 1: Sales handed over a batch of multi-region + isolation asks. Need to firm launch gates for a Q3 pilot (routing precedence, residency, and dedicated pool options). What are the non-negotiables?

sandeep_arch: Architecture summary: want a staged policy rollout by tenant tier (free / standard / enterprise). Core features: region-affinity, fallback lanes to global pool, and an eviction policy for overloaded nodes. Open question: precedence between cost-optimized routing and strict affinity.

mike_infra: From infra: we can do soft isolation (affinity + spill) without reserved capacity. Dedicated pools require reserved capacity and changes to billing/commit models. Also need autoscale safety thresholds and a cross-region kill-switch.

chloe_sales: Customer asks weve collected: (a) EU data residency for regulated customers, (b) enterprise SLA: 99.95% uptime & p95 latency < 200ms, (c) offer for dedicated pools to top customers — they can sign commitments.

elaine_pm: Draft launch gates: 1) residency/legal contracts signed for regulated tenants; 2) run canary with 5 enterprise tenants for 2 weeks; 3) telemetry validates p95 <= 200ms & errors < 0.1%; 4) documented rollback and automated fallback to global pool. Anything else?

sandeep_arch: Add a compatibility check: ensure the model variant + quantization profile is supported on the target pool before routing. Suggest simple routing precedence: 
```
PRIORITY: tenant-dedicated > region-affinity > global-fallback
```
Also, add telemetry for egress and cross-region traffic to spot unexpected routing.

mike_infra: Ops requirements: autoscale safety matrix, emergency failover kill-switch, and blue/green deploy process for policy updates. Need to test tail latency under mixed batching profiles (small chat + long completions).

elaine_pm: Action items: @sandeep_arch produce a minimal routing precedence spec + compatibility matrix by EOD Wed; @mike_infra provide infra cost delta (dedicated vs soft isolation) and autoscale limits; @chloe_sales list interested enterprise customers and contract status.

chloe_sales: Will compile list and flag customers willing to commit. Legal needs to review residency language before we surface it externally.

sandeep_arch: I'll include a tiny DSL for routing rules so product and legal can read it. Example: 
```
route_rule {
  match: tenant_id in enterprise_list
  action: route_to(dedicated_pool)
  fallback: region_affinity
}
```
Keep Q3 scope minimal.

infra-bot: deploy-checker: flagged two infra playbook items: (1) kill-switch doc, (2) autoscale safety matrix. See internal runbook link placeholder.

elaine_pm: TL;DR: Target a gated Q3 pilot: 5 enterprise canaries, signed residency contracts where needed, infra playbook items completed, and a routing precedence spec. If metrics hold, expand to ~20 tenants in Q4. Scheduling 30m sync Fri to review drafts. :thumbsup:

mike_infra: Friday 10am works. I'll bring cost sims and tail-latency charts under mixed workload emulation.

sandeep_arch: Happy to share the compatibility matrix earlier if useful; can slot Thu afternoon.

elaine_pm: Great 1. I'll send the invite and a short agenda.
